title: Stranger Queen: Marti Gould Cummings
description: Drag performer Marti Gould Cummings tells spooky, campfire-style stories about growing up in a haunted house and the psychic who predicted their path. A pre-Spooky Bear Wednesday show in Purgatory; it repeats Friday Oct 30.

title: Country Line Dancing
description: Weekly Wednesday country line dancing night at the Gifford House, listed on the ptownie calendar for Oct 28. Boots and jeans suggested.
notes: Recurring weekly listing; not confirmed on venue site.

title: Early Bear Meet Up
description: The official Northeast Ursamen Thursday-night welcome for Spooky Bear weekend, held at the second-floor Porch Bar. A free, casual meet-and-greet before the night's parties.

title: Stranger Queen: Marti Gould Cummings
